pages.title: Penning Harness
pages.text: Coils across the shoulders, electrodes at wrist and ankle, a faint blue hum. It holds a bubble of field a hair thick around the wearer, and nothing gets through it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The first step into the Antiverse lit me up like a flare. A Penning trap holds a cloud of positrons forever without walls - I scaled one up and wore it.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.
